description: [alias of cuba_proyecto] Project scoping (v0.8): isolate memories per project so multiple projects sharing one DB don't bleed into each other. Active project is bound to the current session (cuba_jornada start --project NAME). Legacy NULL project_id rows are hidden while a project is active unless faro include_unscoped=true or you backfill them.

action.description: Project action. backfill assigns every NULL project_id row to `name` (dry-run unless confirm=true).

confirm.description: backfill only: write the assignment. Default false (dry-run).

name: memory_proyecto
